description: A SOC 1/2/3, ISO certificate, penetration-test or other assurance report → who assured what, for which period, with which exceptions.
instructions: The document is an assurance artefact about a service organisation or system. Identify the report or certificate type, the organisation covered, the auditor or certification body, the period or validity dates, the systems, locations or services in scope, the opinion or result, and every exception, deviation or finding listed — each as one short line.

fields.name: reportType
fields.description: e.g. SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001 certificate, penetration test

fields.name: periodStart
fields.description: Start of period or issue date

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Systems, services or locations in scope

fields.name: exceptions
fields.description: Exceptions, deviations or findings, one line each
